indication: Previously untreated locally recurrent inoperable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer
intervention: Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV q3w + investigator-choice chemotherapy (nab-paclitaxel, paclitaxel, or gemcitabine/carboplatin)
endpoint: PFS in CPS >=10 (primary); OS reported later
effect_size: PFS HR 0.65 (CPS >=10); OS HR 0.73 (CPS >=10, KEYNOTE-355 final)
inclusion_match_notes: Patient is treatment-naive de novo M1 TNBC, ECOG 1. KEYNOTE-355 is the 1L registrational backbone if PD-L1 CPS by 22C3 returns >=10. The TIL-rich, TMB-14 phenotype reinforces ICI rationale even though the label is anchored on CPS, not TMB or TILs. PD-L1 CPS is pending; if CPS <10, the regimen is off-label.
intervention_dosing: Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV q3w (or 400 mg q6w) + chemo until progression

indication: Pretreated metastatic triple-negative breast cancer (>=2 prior lines including a taxane)
intervention: Sacituzumab govitecan 10 mg/kg IV days 1, 8 of a 21-day cycle
comparator: Treatment of physician's choice (eribulin, capecitabine, gemcitabine, or vinorelbine)
inclusion_match_notes: Sacituzumab govitecan is FDA-approved 2L+ TNBC, not directly enrollable now (patient is 1L treatment-naive). The row anchors the basal-like / TROP2 ADC axis as a near-term option after progression. Worth keeping in the dossier because the basal subtype and the absence of prior therapy make this the most likely 2L drug if she progresses on a 1L ICI + chemo regimen.
intervention_dosing: 10 mg/kg IV days 1, 8 q21d

indication: HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer with germline BRCA1/2 mutation (TNBC or HR+; up to 2 prior chemo lines)
intervention: Olaparib 300 mg PO BID
comparator: Physician's choice single-agent chemotherapy (capecitabine, vinorelbine, eribulin)
effect_size: PFS HR 0.58; median PFS 7.0 vs 4.2 mo
inclusion_match_notes: OlympiAD enrolled HER2-negative mBC with germline BRCA1/2 and up to 2 prior chemo lines; the patient is BRCA1-mutated, treatment-naive, TNBC — a textbook fit for olaparib if the BRCA1 call resolves to germline. If somatic-only, the FDA approval for olaparib in breast cancer is restricted to germline BRCA, so eligibility hinges on the germline test ordered in target_validation. Recruitment is closed but the drug is FDA-approved and immediately prescribable.
intervention_dosing: 300 mg PO BID continuous

indication: Locally advanced or metastatic HER2-negative breast cancer with germline BRCA1/2 mutation
intervention: Talazoparib 1 mg PO daily
comparator: Physician's choice chemotherapy (capecitabine, eribulin, gemcitabine, vinorelbine)
effect_size: PFS HR 0.54; median PFS 8.6 vs 5.6 mo
inclusion_match_notes: EMBRACA is the second registrational PARP-inhibitor trial in germline-BRCA HER2-negative breast cancer; patient meets indication subject to germline resolution. The choice between olaparib (OlympiAD) and talazoparib (EMBRACA) often comes down to hematologic-toxicity tolerance — talazoparib has higher anemia rates. Either is the strongest 1L single-agent option for a BRCA1-mutated mTNBC who declines or progresses through chemo.
intervention_dosing: 1 mg PO daily continuous

indication: Previously untreated metastatic TNBC
intervention: Atezolizumab 840 mg IV days 1, 15 + nab-paclitaxel 100 mg/m^2 days 1, 8, 15 q28d
endpoint: PFS overall and in PD-L1+ subgroup
effect_size: PFS HR 0.62 in PD-L1+ (7.5 vs 5.0 mo)
inclusion_match_notes: IMpassion130 led to the original accelerated approval of atezolizumab + nab-paclitaxel for 1L mTNBC with SP142 IC >=1%, but the indication was voluntarily withdrawn in the US in 2021 after IMpassion131 failed to confirm benefit with paclitaxel solvent. Kept in the dossier as the historical immune-chemo registration anchor; the patient cannot enroll, and the regimen is no longer the labeled 1L ICI option in the US. The pembrolizumab + chemo (KEYNOTE-355) row is the active equivalent.
intervention_dosing: 840 mg IV days 1, 15 + nab-paclitaxel 100 mg/m^2 days 1, 8, 15 q28d

indication: Early-stage (II-III) triple-negative breast cancer, neoadjuvant
intervention: Pembrolizumab + paclitaxel + carboplatin (then doxorubicin/cyclophosphamide), then adjuvant pembrolizumab
inclusion_match_notes: KEYNOTE-522 is the neoadjuvant standard for high-risk early-stage TNBC and the foundation for ICI + chemo in TNBC generally. Included as informational because the patient is M1 at presentation, not stage II-III. The TIL-3+ / TMB-14 phenotype is exactly the population that benefits most in KEYNOTE-522 retrospectively, which strengthens the case for a KEYNOTE-355-style ICI + chemo 1L regimen.
intervention_dosing: Pembrolizumab 200 mg q3w during neoadjuvant + adjuvant phases

indication: Advanced solid tumors with TMB-H (>=10 mut/Mb by FoundationOne CDx)
design: single-arm, prospectively-defined TMB-H cohort within a multi-cohort phase 2
intervention: Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV q3w
effect_size: ORR 29% in TMB-H vs 6% in non-TMB-H
inclusion_match_notes: KEYNOTE-158 is the tumor-agnostic pembrolizumab basket the patient's TMB-14 mut/Mb call qualifies for under the 2020 FDA label (TMB-H >=10 mut/Mb by F1CDx). The label is restricted to patients who have progressed on >=1 prior line and have no satisfactory alternatives — the patient is 1L treatment-naive, so the label does not yet apply, but the result is decision-relevant context for a future line. Confirm the TMB call was made on F1CDx (target_validation row tmb-panel-assay-confirmation).
intervention_dosing: 200 mg IV q3w (or 400 mg q6w)

indication: High-risk early-stage HER2-negative breast cancer with germline BRCA1/2 mutation (adjuvant)
intervention: Olaparib 300 mg PO BID for 12 months adjuvant
effect_size: iDFS HR 0.58 (3-yr iDFS 85.9% vs 77.1%); OS HR 0.68
inclusion_match_notes: OlympiA established adjuvant olaparib in germline-BRCA early breast cancer (TNBC or HR+, high-risk after neoadjuvant or adjuvant chemo). If the de novo oligometastatic disease converts on systemic therapy and local consolidation is pursued, the question of post-consolidation adjuvant olaparib is off-label but precedent-rich.

sponsor: AstraZeneca / Breast International Group / NRG Oncology

indication: Locally advanced or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer, 1L
biomarker: PIK3CA / AKT1 / PTEN alteration not required for enrollment but stratified
intervention: Capivasertib 400 mg PO BID days 2-5 weekly + paclitaxel 80 mg/m^2 IV weekly
endpoint: OS in overall and AKT-pathway-altered populations
effect_size: — (primary readout reported negative for OS at 2024 ESMO)
quality: low risk of bias (phase 3 design); primary OS not met
inclusion_match_notes: CAPItello-290 is the dedicated 1L mTNBC trial of capivasertib + paclitaxel; the patient's PIK3CA mutation + PTEN loss puts her in the AKT-pathway-altered stratum where benefit was expected. The trial is closed to enrollment and the primary OS endpoint was not met overall, but a biomarker-altered subgroup readout is still relevant for off-label discussion. Capivasertib + fulvestrant is approved in HR+ HER2- breast cancer (CAPItello-291); TNBC use would be off-label without trial access.
intervention_dosing: Capivasertib 400 mg PO BID days 2-5/week + paclitaxel 80 mg/m^2 days 1, 8, 15 q28d

indication: Previously untreated locally recurrent inoperable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer ineligible for PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors
biomarker: PD-L1 CPS <10 by 22C3 or other ICI ineligibility
intervention: Datopotamab deruxtecan 6 mg/kg IV q3w
comparator: Investigator's choice chemotherapy (paclitaxel, nab-paclitaxel, carboplatin, capecitabine, eribulin)
effect_size: PFS HR 0.57; median PFS 10.8 vs 5.6 mo
inclusion_match_notes: TROPION-Breast02 is the 1L PD-L1-low / ICI-ineligible TNBC pivotal for Dato-DXd. The patient's PD-L1 CPS is pending; if CPS <10 she lands in this trial's target population. The 1L TROP2-ADC mechanism directly targets the basal-like feature axis. The trial is no longer actively recruiting; the result anchors a likely FDA label expansion that would make Dato-DXd an off-label / on-label 1L option depending on the final indication wording.
intervention_dosing: 6 mg/kg IV q3w

indication: PD-L1 CPS >=10 locally recurrent inoperable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer, 1L
intervention: Datopotamab deruxtecan +/- durvalumab
comparator: Investigator's choice chemo (paclitaxel, nab-paclitaxel, gemcitabine/carboplatin) + pembrolizumab

If the patient's pending PD-L1 CPS returns >=10, she is a near-ideal candidate: 1L, ECOG 1, TROP2-ADC mechanism directly targets the basal feature, durvalumab arm leverages TMB-H / TIL-rich phenotype. Strong fit subject to PD-L1 confirmation.
intervention_dosing: Dato-DXd 6 mg/kg IV q3w +/- durvalumab 1120 mg IV q3w

indication: Locally recurrent inoperable or metastatic TNBC, 1L, PD-L1 CPS <10
intervention: Sacituzumab tirumotecan (sac-TMT, MK-2870) 4 mg/kg IV q2w as monotherapy or + pembrolizumab
comparator: Investigator's choice chemo (paclitaxel, nab-paclitaxel, or gemcitabine/carboplatin)
inclusion_match_notes: TroFuse-011 tests sacituzumab tirumotecan (Merck's TROP2 ADC, partnered from Kelun) +/- pembrolizumab vs. chemo in 1L PD-L1-low mTNBC. The patient fits if PD-L1 CPS returns <10. Pipeline-context for the TROP2 ADC class: same target as sacituzumab govitecan and datopotamab deruxtecan but a different payload-linker chemistry, so it complements rather than duplicates the Dato-DXd row. Open and recruiting.
intervention_dosing: 4 mg/kg IV q2w +/- pembrolizumab 400 mg q6w

indication: Advanced TNBC, any line
biomarker: MYC pathway not formally required for enrollment; rationale focused on basal/MYC-driven TNBC
intervention: ZEN-3694 (BET inhibitor) + pembrolizumab + nab-paclitaxel
inclusion_match_notes: NCI-sponsored phase 1b of the BET inhibitor ZEN-3694 layered on pembrolizumab + nab-paclitaxel: the closest active trial to the patient's MYC-amplification + basal/TIL-rich + ICI-favorable axis. The trial enrolls advanced TNBC patients (including some 1L) and pre-specifies a MYC-amplified expansion; the patient's MYC-amp call is decision-relevant. Currently recruiting at NCI sites. The combination raises the bar for hematologic and neuropathy toxicity from nab-paclitaxel — not a veto for this patient (efficacy_toxicity_weight 0.7, no vetoes set).
intervention_dosing: ZEN-3694 oral daily + pembrolizumab 200 mg q3w + nab-paclitaxel 100 mg/m^2 days 1, 8, 15 q28d

indication: Platinum-pretreated advanced triple-negative breast cancer (maintenance after platinum response)
biomarker: HRD-positive / BRCA-mutant enriched but not required
intervention: Olaparib 300 mg PO BID +/- durvalumab 1500 mg q4w
inclusion_match_notes: DORA tests a chemo-free PARPi + ICI maintenance after platinum induction in mTNBC, directly relevant for the BRCA1 + TIL-rich + TMB-H phenotype, but the design requires prior platinum exposure, so it is not enrollable in 1L. Kept as a strategy template: induction with platinum-containing chemo (with or without pembrolizumab) followed by olaparib + durvalumab maintenance is a defensible off-trial regimen for this patient given her BRCA1 status and ICI-favorable phenotype.
intervention_dosing: Olaparib 300 mg PO BID continuous +/- durvalumab 1500 mg IV q4w

indication: Locally recurrent inoperable or metastatic TNBC after induction with 1L pembrolizumab + chemo
intervention: Pembrolizumab 200 mg q3w + olaparib 300 mg BID maintenance after pembro+chemo induction
inclusion_match_notes: KEYLYNK-009 tested whether switching from pembro+chemo to pembro+olaparib maintenance improves outcomes in mTNBC. Overall negative but the HRR-mut subgroup signal (PFS HR ~0.65) supports the strategy of pembro+chemo induction followed by olaparib-based maintenance for BRCA1-mutant patients like ours. Closed to enrollment; result is decision-relevant for off-trial maintenance strategy choice.
intervention_dosing: Olaparib 300 mg PO BID + pembrolizumab 200 mg IV q3w maintenance after 4-6 cycles of induction chemo+pembro

indication: Germline BRCA-mutated HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer
intervention: Olaparib 300 mg PO BID + durvalumab 1500 mg IV q4w
inclusion_match_notes: MEDIOLA showed strong activity for olaparib + durvalumab in germline BRCA-mut HER2-neg mBC: small but mechanistically clean. The patient's BRCA1 + TIL-rich + TMB-H profile is the exact phenotype most likely to benefit. Trial is closed; the regimen is off-label outside of trials. Provides the rationale for a PARPi + ICI maintenance strategy after platinum-containing 1L induction, complementary to DORA and KEYLYNK-009.
intervention_dosing: Olaparib 300 mg PO BID + durvalumab 1500 mg IV q4w

indication: Advanced or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer
intervention: Niraparib 200 mg PO daily + pembrolizumab 200 mg IV q3w

The patient is BRCA1+ TIL-rich TMB-H, almost the canonical TOPACIO responder. Trial is completed and niraparib is not labeled in breast cancer in the US, so off-trial use is off-label and may have payer hurdles. Decision-relevant for the 2L maintenance design choice.
intervention_dosing: Niraparib 200 mg PO daily + pembrolizumab 200 mg IV q3w

indication: Metastatic breast cancer with somatic BRCA1/2 mutation
intervention: Talazoparib 1 mg PO daily

This Stanford / TBCRC trial extends talazoparib activity beyond the germline-only OlympiAD / EMBRACA labels, which is exactly the off-label uncertainty the patient lives with. Recruiting; biomarker-restricted; the patient's BRCA1-somatic call (if confirmed) makes her directly eligible.

indication: Metastatic TNBC stratified by HRR mutation status
biomarker: HRR mutation including BRCA1/2 (stratified); HR-deficient enriched
intervention: Olaparib + ceralasertib (AZD6738) vs olaparib + adavosertib (closed) vs olaparib monotherapy
effect_size: Olaparib + ceralasertib PFS HR ~0.81 in BRCA-mut; ~0.93 in HRR-mut non-BRCA
inclusion_match_notes: VIOLETTE was the dedicated PARPi + DDR combination phase 2 in mTNBC. The adavosertib (WEE1) arm closed early; the ceralasertib (ATR) arm did not improve PFS over olaparib alone overall but is the cleanest evidence for the BRCA1 + TP53 replication-stress combination rationale. The patient's BRCA1 + TP53 + PTEN pattern fits the mechanistic hypothesis even though VIOLETTE was negative. Trial closed; included for the BRCA1+TP53 DDR-combination context.
intervention_dosing: Olaparib 300 mg PO BID + ceralasertib 160 mg PO days 1-7 of 28-day cycle

indication: PIK3CA-mutant metastatic triple-negative breast cancer
intervention: Inavolisib (GDC-0077) + eribulin
inclusion_match_notes: Zhejiang Cancer Hospital trial of inavolisib + eribulin in PIK3CA-mutant mTNBC — directly leverages the patient's PIK3CA + PTEN feature axis. Currently not-yet-recruiting; eribulin backbone means the trial is restricted to taxane-pretreated patients, so the patient would need to progress on a 1L taxane-containing regimen first. Inavolisib is FDA-approved (Oct 2024) for HR+/HER2- + PIK3CA mut + endocrine-resistant breast cancer; off-label in TNBC. PIK3CA hotspot confirmation (target_validation row pik3ca-hotspot-confirmation) is the gating step.

Included as informational context for the basal/TROP2 ADC + ICI axis after potential 1L conversion + local consolidation. If oligometastatic conversion is achieved and the team pursues a post-consolidation adjuvant strategy, the ASCENT-05 framework is the closest published template.
intervention_dosing: Sacituzumab govitecan 10 mg/kg IV days 1, 8 q21d + pembrolizumab 400 mg q6w

indication: Newly oligometastatic breast cancer (1-4 metastases) of any subtype, on standard systemic therapy
intervention: Standard systemic therapy + SBRT or surgical resection of all metastases
endpoint: Safety (primary); PFS phase IIR readout reported negative at SABCS 2024
effect_size: phase IIR PFS HR ~1.31 (favors control); 3-yr PFS no different
inclusion_match_notes: The patient is de novo oligometastatic (single 1.5 cm liver lesion). NRG-BR002 is the only phase III oligometastatic-breast trial; the phase IIR PFS readout was negative for the consolidation arm, which is decision-relevant evidence against routine SBRT/resection over systemic therapy alone. The result tempers the curative-intent framing for this patient, though biology-driven case-by-case consolidation discussions continue in tumor boards. Trial closed.
intervention_dosing: SBRT to all metastatic lesions per RTOG guidelines or surgical resection, layered on systemic therapy

indication: Metastatic breast cancer with oligoprogressive or oligometastatic disease on systemic therapy
intervention: SBRT to all sites of oligometastatic / oligoprogressive disease + ongoing systemic therapy
inclusion_match_notes: MSK SABR consolidation phase 2 — actively recruiting de novo oligometastatic and oligoprogressive breast/other solid tumors. The patient's single hepatic lesion makes her a candidate after some systemic response is established. Layered consolidation strategy complements the systemic-therapy backbone choice from the other rows; not a substitute for systemic therapy.
intervention_dosing: SBRT per lesion-specific RTOG/AAPM guidelines layered on systemic therapy
